items.title: 3 Airline Stocks To Watch As Lower Oil Prices Ease Cost Pressure
items.summary: Oil just slipped back below the psychological $100 mark for Brent and $90 for WTI, easing some of the pressure that has stalked fuel intensive transport and logistics stocks in recent months. When a key input suddenly gets cheaper, cost structures can look very different, and that can shift how investors think about everything from airlines to freight operators. items.title: Southwest Airlines (LUV) Is Up 5.7% After Pivot To High-Margin Seat And Add-On Fees
items.summary: In recent months, Southwest Airlines has shifted away from its long-standing “no hidden fees” approach by charging for seat assignments and extra legroom, remodeling cabins to support this change and reporting more than US$1.00 billion in EBIT from these extras, with bags also becoming a major revenue contributor. This pivot shows how Southwest is monetizing services it once included in the base fare, aligning itself more closely with rivals while benefiting from higher fares on routes...
